text:
You need Apple Pay and Google Pay embedded into an existing working Tranzila iframe on a WordPress site, with the Apple merchant authentication file placed in the correct .well-known directory and the Tranzila jQuery library loaded and tested before go-live.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I can help you get this working cleanly inside the current setup without disrupting the existing iframe flow. I have 7 years of experience working across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML, and CSS, so I’m comfortable handling both the front-end integration details and the logic required to make a payment flow behave reliably in a live environment.

For a relevant example, I built a Live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight in logistics. It was a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA, pushed to the browser as GPS pings arrived. The result was 1,800 trucks tracked live, with updates reaching the screen in under 2 seconds from ping to screen. That project required careful real-time integration, clean browser-side behavior, and a focus on reliability under live conditions — the same mindset I’d bring to this payment integration.

For your job, I would focus on:
- confirming the Apple Pay verification file is uploaded to the correct .well-known path
- embedding the Apple Pay JS library in the required directory
- ensuring Tranzila jQuery is loaded properly inside the iframe context
- testing the Apple Pay and Google Pay flow end to end
- checking for any browser, iframe, or WordPress-specific issues before go-live

Because this is an embedded payment flow, I’d be careful about order of operations and validation so we don’t introduce issues into a site that is already working. I can work methodically, verify each step, and make sure the implementation is stable before launch.

If you’d like, I can take this on and work through the integration and testing with you.
